cards.title: Anthropic Launches Opus 5 Model
cards.body: Opus 5 is cheaper and less restrictive than Fable, making it preferable for most use cases. The release reflects Anthropic's commitment to advancing capable AI models.

cards.title: OpenAI's ChatGPT Health Available to All
cards.body: ChatGPT Health now integrates with Apple Health, Function, and MyFitnessPal for personalized health insights. The feature is accessible to all US users.

cards.title: Anthropic Updates Claude Voice Mode
cards.body: Claude's new voice model can reschedule meetings and draft emails with enhanced capabilities. The update brings more natural conversational interactions.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches AI Keypad
cards.body: OpenAI released a new AI keypad designed to assist coders with enhanced functionality. The tool offers specialized features for programming workflows.

cards.title: OpenAI Voice Mode Reaches Desktop
cards.body: ChatGPT Voice on desktop now works with ChatGPT Work and Codex for task completion. The feature enables users to control agents via voice.

cards.title: Bluesky's Attie Becomes Research Tool
cards.body: Attie now functions as an open social research tool for Bluesky users. Users can query news, trends, and conversations across AT Protocol apps.

cards.title: AMD Challenges Nvidia With Helios System
cards.body: AMD unveiled the Helios rack-scale AI system to compete with Nvidia's offerings. The system begins shipping to customers later this year.

cards.title: Runway Launches AI Model Router
cards.body: Runway's Media Router automatically selects the best generation model based on quality, speed, or cost priorities. The tool streamlines generative media workflows.

cards.title: Midjourney Acquires Astrology App Co-Star
cards.body: Midjourney expanded beyond image and video generation with the Co-Star acquisition. The move signals the lab's diversification into new AI applications.

cards.title: Cognition Acquires Poke for Devin AI
cards.body: Cognition acquired Poke to enhance its Devin coding agent with conversational personality. The deal reflects how AI interaction style is becoming competitively crucial.

cards.title: Prentis AI Lab Raises $100M Funding
cards.body: Reid Hoffman and Mark Pincus co-founded Prentis to automate routine computer tasks. The lab believes task automation will outpace coding as AI's biggest use case.

cards.title: AegisAI Secures $36M for AI Security
cards.body: AegisAI, founded by former Google security executives, lands funding to combat AI-driven phishing. The company develops agents that detect anomalies human checklists miss.

cards.title: Industry Opposes Broad Open-Weight Restrictions
cards.body: Nvidia, Mistral, and other AI companies urge policymakers against restricting open-weight models. The stance comes as Washington debates responses to Chinese AI advances.

cards.title: Virginia Reveals AI Data Center Vulnerability
cards.body: A downed power line exposed poor grid disruption responses at AI data centers. Infrastructure improvements are needed to prevent future outages.

cards.title: Moonshot's Kimi K3 Sparks US Reaction
cards.body: Chinese AI lab Moonshot's open Kimi model went viral, largely due to US industry responses. An unreleased OpenAI model was also accidentally exposed outside its test environment.

cards.title: Nvidia Sends GPUs to the Moon
cards.body: Nvidia continues expanding GPU deployment to virtually every location, including space missions. The move underscores GPU demand across industries.

cards.title: AI Guardrails Hamper Cybersecurity Research
cards.body: OpenAI and Anthropic guardrails are limiting cybersecurity researchers studying vulnerabilities. Researchers struggle to develop exploits while adhering to safety restrictions.

cards.title: Monday.com Latest Tech Layoff Blamed on AI
cards.body: Monday.com joined 20+ major tech companies citing AI as a factor in layoffs. The trend reflects broader workforce restructuring across the tech industry.

cards.title: Libraries Host 'Avoiding AI' Workshops
cards.body: Libraries nationwide are hosting viral "Avoiding AI" workshops amid unprecedented demand. The workshops respond to growing public concern about Big Tech's AI integration.

cards.title: Meta Runs Controversial AI Optimism Ad
cards.body: Meta launched an AI optimism campaign using David Bowie's "Five Years," which describes human extinction. The ironic choice sparked criticism online.

cards.title: Monday.com Blames AI for Latest Tech Layoffs
cards.body: Monday.com joins 20+ major tech companies citing AI as a factor in significant layoffs this year. The trend highlights how AI automation is reshaping workforce strategies across the industry.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches New AI Keypad Tool
cards.body: OpenAI released a fancy new AI keypad designed primarily for coders. The tool promises to be fun for developers while potentially confusing for general users.

cards.title: Prentis AI Lab Raises $100M for Task Automation
cards.body: Reid Hoffman and Mark Pincus co-founded Prentis, which is betting on automating routine computer tasks as AI's next frontier. The lab is in talks to raise $100 million for its vision.

cards.title: Cognition Acquires Poke for AI Personality
cards.body: Cognition acquired Poke to enhance its coding agent Devin with better conversational abilities. The move signals that AI interaction style is becoming as competitive as the underlying models.

cards.title: Anthropic Launches Cheaper Opus 5 Model
cards.body: Anthropic released Opus 5, a cheaper and less restrictive alternative to Fable. The model is expected to be preferable for most common use cases.

cards.title: AI Industry Opposes Broad Open-Weight Restrictions
cards.body: Nvidia, Mistral, and other AI companies urged policymakers against restricting open-weight AI models. The push comes as Washington debates responses to Chinese AI development.

cards.title: Bluesky's AI Assistant Attie Expands Features
cards.body: Bluesky's Attie AI assistant now works as an open research tool across the AT Protocol. Users can ask questions about news, trends, and conversations on multiple platforms.

cards.title: Midjourney Acquires Astrology App Co-Star
cards.body: AI image and video lab Midjourney expanded beyond creative generation by acquiring astrology app Co-Star. The acquisition marks another diversification move for the company.

cards.title: Chinese AI Model Kimi K3 Rattles Wall Street
cards.body: Moonshot's open model Kimi went viral, sparking concern among U.S. AI firms. An unreleased OpenAI model also leaked from testing, triggering industry anxiety about security.

cards.title: OpenAI Brings Voice Mode to ChatGPT Desktop
cards.body: ChatGPT Voice is now available on desktop apps for ChatGPT Work and Codex. The feature enables voice-based task completion and agent control.

cards.title: AI Guardrails Hamper Cybersecurity Researchers
cards.body: OpenAI and Anthropic's safety guardrails are impeding offensive security research work. Cybersecurity experts say restrictions on vulnerability research tools limit their ability to find exploits.

cards.title: AMD Challenges Nvidia with Helios AI System
cards.body: AMD unveiled its Helios rack-scale system to compete with Nvidia's AI infrastructure dominance. The system will start shipping to customers later this year.

cards.title: Claude Voice Mode Gets More Capable Models
cards.body: Anthropic updated Claude's voice capabilities with enhanced AI models. Users can now reschedule meetings and draft emails through voice interaction.

cards.title: AegisAI Lands $36M to Stop AI Phishing
cards.body: Former Google security executives founded AegisAI, which raised $36 million to combat AI-driven spear phishing. The startup uses AI agents to detect anomalies humans might miss.

cards.title: Runway Launches AI Model Router Tool
cards.body: Runway released Media Router to automatically select the best generative AI model for each request. The tool optimizes based on quality, speed, or cost priorities.

cards.title: OpenAI Rolls Out ChatGPT Health to All Users
cards.body: ChatGPT Health is now available to all U.S. users with data integration from Apple Health and fitness apps. The feature enables AI-powered personalized health insights.

cards.title: How AI Helps Design Next-Gen Medicines
cards.body: AI is accelerating drug discovery by helping scientists design new medicines faster and cheaper. The technology reduces development time and failure rates for biologic therapies.

cards.title: AlphaFold Redesigns Gene-Editing Proteins Safely
cards.body: Researchers used AlphaFold AI to redesign gene-editing proteins for improved safety. The breakthrough demonstrates AI's potential in enhancing medical biotechnology.

cards.title: Canadian Legislator Reads LLM Response in Speech
cards.body: A Canadian politician inadvertently read out an apparent large language model response during a floor speech. The incident highlights concerns about AI-generated content in governance.

cards.title: Anthropic's Opus 5 Focuses on Token Efficiency
cards.body: Opus 5 prioritizes token efficiency rather than major capability leaps. The model offers cost and performance improvements for practical use cases.

cards.title: Trump EPA May Weaken Data Center Oversight
cards.body: AI firms seeking more data centers may get relief under Trump's EPA reducing neighbor regulations. The policy shift could accelerate AI infrastructure expansion.

cards.title: Google Adds Selfie Login Option for Passwords
cards.body: Google introduced facial recognition as a password recovery option. Users can now log in with a selfie instead of traditional password reset methods.
